text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Woo-hoo! We did it, Trainer! A proud 
number one!"
choice_data_list:
Yeah, that run was flawless in both 
technique and heart!

Yeah, that was a flawless run in both 
skill and spirit!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was perfect. And so was the race 
plan you came up with♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
She analyzed her rivals' data, 
meticulously studied the quirks of the 
track, and showed me how to fight.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Without my Trainer's help, I don't know if 
I could have done this well.
choice_data_list:
You're the one who ran. It's not my 
accomplishment—

You're the one who ran. It's not my 
accomplishment—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No. Don't put yourself down. I gave the 
run of my life, and you did an incredible 
job.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
This is a victory we seized together. So 
let's hold our heads high and be proud of 
it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"In any case, with you as my Trainer, 
reaching the throne of my ideal Queen 
doesn't feel like a mere pipe dream 
anymore."
choice_data_list:
Let's climb all the way to the top like 
this!

Let's take it one step at a time without 
getting conceited.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Good! That's great, love that enthusiasm!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If my Trainer is passionate, I can burn 
just as bright. It's the ideal 
relationship.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show you the best view ever, so 
stick with me right to the end!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how cautious of you. But I appreciate 
it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"A fiery heart is essential for racing, 
but at the same time, you need to stay 
cool, too."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Looks like choosing you as my Trainer was 
definitely the right call!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Stay cool, yet burn with passion! Let's 
seize the top spot without fail!
